hooks.command: LOCK="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/.install.lock"; REQ="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/requirements.txt"; CACHED="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/requirements.txt"; V="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/venv"; if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then exit 0; fi; diff -q "$REQ" "$CACHED" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; touch "$LOCK" && { { python3 -m venv "$V" && "$V/bin/pip" install -q -r "$REQ"; } 2>/dev/null || { command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv venv -q --allow-existing "$V" && uv pip install -q --python "$V/bin/python3" -r "$REQ"; }; } && cp "$REQ" "$CACHED" && rm -f "$LOCK" || rm -f "$LOCK"
